data.title: Kettles
data.text: I have Tomas Lind's notebooks in Carran. He measured the Vell every September, and his chalet, with kettles on every shelf, is intact. The Upper Vell dam and the fjord chapel are gone. The village lift and village barn remain intact. The river is brown, the sky is grey, and soot has darkened the snow. Extraction, industry and energy you toppled earlier made this land clearly worse. The thaw had already been set in motion by choices made across the valley and far beyond it. I sharpen my pencil over Tomas's measurements.
